statements.text: Three months later, in June, the government announced 25 percent tariffs on $50 billion worth of Chinese imports (including cars).
From 3 May 2025, the 25% tariff will then also be applied to automotive components.
On 9 April 2025, President Trump caved in to pressure from the stock and bond markets and reneged on his widely derided tariff policy.
From 3 April 2025, 25% tariffs on all vehicle imports – except for Canada and Mexico, where USMCA compliant parts and vehicles will remain exempt.

Automotive component suppliers, especially small and medium sized tier suppliers , will not be able to reshore component manufacturing to the US as higher labour costs impact their financial viability.
governments are forcing the localization of semiconductor chips, sensors, lithium for EV batteries, and rare-earth metals for EV motors.

The automotive industry is undergoing a significant transformation as it shifts from a globalized model to a more localized approach. This change is driven by recent geopolitical events, protectionist policies, and the need for greater supply chain resilience.

Auto manufacturers and suppliers must adapt by investing in local production facilities, building stronger relationships with local suppliers, and embracing advanced technologies to maintain competitiveness.
By focusing on localized operations and leveraging digital tools, the industry can navigate these changes and continue to thrive in a more regionalized market.

In August 2022, the IRA, included a provision that aimed to enhance EV sales by providing tax credits of up to $7 ,500 on eligible North America-produced EVs (eligibility based on varying percentage criteria of EV material sourcing, parts production, and vehicle assembly in North America).
The Department of Energy (DOE) provided $15.5 billion to incentivize the electric vehicle (EV) transition, highlighting the move toward domestic EV production and the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA)
In March 2018, the US government imposed a 25 percent import tariff on steel and a 10 percent import tariff on aluminum to protect domestic producers.
